scope: Complete reading of 576 saved abstracts, unfiltered indices 385-960, by three reviewers with disjoint 192-record assignments. Source/ID records include reviews, preprints and publication versions; not independent studies or full-text efficacy assessments. Historical abstract flags remain unchanged by later primary follow-up. One per-record note was refined after independent source checking, as listed in integration_refinements; part hashes identify the original reviewer files.

records.title: A co-formulation of interferons alpha2b and gamma distinctively targets cell cycle in the glioblastoma-derived cell line U-87MG.
records.note: The interferon co-formulation suppressed mitotic transcriptional programs and produced dose- and time-dependent arrest. This is tumor growth inhibition rather than evidence of improved segregation or organismal function.
records.uncertainty: No MVA or deficient-checkpoint rescue was studied.

records.title: Screening and Identification of Potential Biomarkers in Hepatitis B Virus-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.note: Expression and survival analyses nominated mitotic genes as HCC biomarkers. No intervention or functional rescue was tested.
records.uncertainty: Association cannot establish a compensatory treatment.

records.title: Stable kinetochore-microtubule attachments restrict MTOC position and spindle elongation in oocytes.
records.note: Stable kinetochore attachments constrained spindle length and positioned microtubule organizing centers. Disrupting attachments impaired this spindle organization.
records.uncertainty: The saved abstract does not name a perturbing agent or demonstrate therapeutic rescue.

records.title: RNA interference-mediated silencing of the polo-like kinase 1 gene enhances chemosensitivity to gemcitabine in pancreatic adenocarcinoma cells.
records.note: PLK1 depletion sensitized cancer cells to gemcitabine and increased apoptosis, while PLK1 overexpression reduced sensitivity. The beneficial endpoint was cancer cell killing.
records.uncertainty: PLK1 siRNA is a genetic perturbation and no normal-cell fidelity benefit is reported.

records.title: Analysis of the retinal gene expression profile after hypoxic preconditioning identifies candidate genes for neuroprotection.
records.model: Animal model of light-induced retinal degeneration
records.note: Hypoxic preconditioning protected photoreceptors and induced multiple candidate protective genes, while p21 was dispensable. This supports physiological compensation and motivates target clarification around HIF-associated and antioxidant responses.
records.uncertainty: No drug was administered and the causal contribution of individual induced genes remains unresolved.

records.title: SIRT2 regulates nuclear envelope reassembly through ANKLE2 deacetylation.
records.note: Both SIRT2 depletion and overexpression caused nuclear-envelope reassembly defects, linked to ANKLE2 modification. SIRT2 dosage therefore appears constrained rather than monotonically protective.
records.uncertainty: No administered compound, dose window, or MVA model is described.

records.title: Characterization of unconventional kinetochore kinases KKT10 and KKT19 in <i>Trypanosoma brucei</i>.
records.note: Redundant KKT10/KKT19 kinases controlled kinetochore phosphorylation and mitotic timing. Combined depletion delayed anaphase in a parasite lacking a canonical spindle checkpoint.
records.uncertainty: Parasite-specific mechanisms provide no tested mammalian rescue.

records.title: The Involvement of Ubiquitination Machinery in Cell Cycle Regulation and Cancer Progression.
records.note: The review describes how ubiquitination governs cell-cycle regulators and genomic stability. It supplies no new administered-agent efficacy experiment.
records.uncertainty: Review material is not independent replication.

records.title: Unraveling molecular similarities between colorectal polyps and colorectal cancer: a systems biology approach.
records.note: Shared expression networks and transcription factors were identified across polyps and colorectal cancer. No treatment or functional compensation was assessed.
records.uncertainty: Proposed targets are associative.

records.title: Centromere fragmentation is a common mitotic defect of S and G2 checkpoint override.
records.note: Combining DNA damage with unnamed Chk1 inhibitors forced premature mitosis and fragmented centromeres and kinetochores. This is direct counterevidence against treating checkpoint override as fidelity restoration.
records.uncertainty: Chk1 inhibitor identities and relevance at tolerable exposures in BUB1B deficiency remain unspecified.

records.title: Molecular mechanism of G<sub>1</sub> arrest and cellular senescence induced by LEE011, a novel CDK4/CDK6 inhibitor, in leukemia cells.
records.model: Acute leukemia cell lines including HL-60
records.note: LEE011 inhibited proliferation and induced G1 arrest, senescence, and some apoptosis. The outcome does not show healthy-cell functional rescue.
records.uncertainty: There is no deficient-checkpoint model or evidence that induced senescence benefits MVA.

records.title: RB's original CIN?
records.note: This commentary discusses RB control of chromosome condensation, centromeres, and stability based on other studies. It reports no independent intervention experiment.
records.uncertainty: Primary studies would be needed for any specific rescue claim.

records.title: Cell cycle progression score is a marker for five-year lung cancer-specific mortality risk in patients with resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma patients
records.note: A proliferation signature predicted lung-cancer mortality following surgery. No drug efficacy or checkpoint compensation was tested.
records.uncertainty: Prognostic discrimination is not intervention evidence.

records.title: DNA Damage: A Main Determinant of Vascular Aging.
records.note: The review connects genomic instability to vascular dysfunction and discusses signaling and dietary remedies. No named administered agent or new efficacy result is given.
records.uncertainty: Underlying intervention studies require separate assessment and cannot count as replication here.

records.title: Important molecular genetic markers of colorectal cancer.
records.note: The abstract surveys molecular biomarkers used for prognosis and treatment sensitivity. It contains no specific administered treatment result.
records.uncertainty: Biomarker review content does not establish a rescue strategy.

records.title: Emi2-mediated inhibition of E2-substrate ubiquitin transfer by the anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome through a D-box-independent mechanism.
records.note: Emi2 blocked the ubiquitin-transfer step of Cdc20-dependent APC/C activity rather than merely competing as a substrate. This suggests a timing-control mechanism but no functional rescue intervention.
records.uncertainty: No drug or BUB1B-deficient model is tested.

records.title: Hepatic Transcriptome Responses in Mice (Mus musculus) Exposed to the Nafion Membrane and Its Combustion Products.
records.note: Polymer and combustion-product exposures altered hepatic pathology, oxidative-stress markers, and gene pathways. These are toxicity exposures rather than therapeutic candidates.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not resolve mixture constituents or a beneficial efficacy endpoint.

records.title: Therapeutic misalignment averted by clonal evolutionary evidence: molecular confirmation of hepatic metastasis in SMARCA4-deficient non-small cell lung cancer initially misdiagnosed as resectable cholangiocarcinoma.
records.note: Molecular lineage analysis corrected a liver-lesion diagnosis to lung-cancer metastasis. The study does not report drug administration or therapeutic response.
records.uncertainty: Diagnostic utility cannot be interpreted as functional treatment evidence.

records.title: Rho GTPase-independent regulation of mitotic progression by the RhoGEF Net1.
records.note: Net1 depletion destabilized kinetochore attachments and activated the spindle checkpoint, while catalytically inactive Net1 rescued depletion-associated effects. Both depletion and overexpression caused defects, suggesting a dosage-sensitive scaffold function.
records.uncertainty: The rescue is genetic, and no compound or BUB1B-deficient rescue is demonstrated.

records.title: Exploration of genetic basis underlying individual differences in radiosensitivity within human populations using genome editing technology.
records.model: Human cultured cells with ATM heterozygous mutations
records.note: Genome editing linked heterozygous ATM mutations to increased radiation-induced chromosome aberrations. The abstract motivates genetic radiosensitivity studies rather than treatment.
records.uncertainty: No named administered compound or protective intervention is provided.

records.title: Increased Postnatal Cardiac Hyperplasia Precedes Cardiomyocyte Hypertrophy in a Model of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
records.note: Increased cardiomyocyte cycling preceded hypertrophy in a genetic cardiomyopathy model. No therapeutic intervention was evaluated.
records.uncertainty: Potential treatment windows remain untested.

records.title: HDAC8 drives spindle organization during meiotic maturation of porcine oocytes.
records.note: PCI-34051 reproduced HDAC8-depletion defects, including abnormal spindles, misaligned chromosomes, and meiotic failure. The findings caution against assuming HDAC8 inhibition improves chromosome handling.
records.uncertainty: Whether this oocyte toxicity predicts effects in BUB1B-deficient somatic tissue is unknown.

records.title: Kinetochores expand their reach
records.note: The short saved abstract states that extended kinetochore filaments may aid checkpoint activation and microtubule capture. It names no intervention or measured rescue.
records.uncertainty: The complete saved text repeats one sentence and supplies no experimental details.

records.title: Ionizing radiation-dependent and independent phosphorylation of the 32-kDa subunit of replication protein A during mitosis.
records.note: Ionizing radiation induced RPA2 hyperphosphorylation and relocalization through DNA-damage signaling. The work characterizes a damage response without a rescue treatment.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or beneficial endpoint is described.

records.title: Mechanisms and regulation underlying membraneless organelle plasticity control.
records.note: The review explains phase separation and its regulation in cellular organization and disease. It provides no specific administered-agent rescue result.
records.uncertainty: Broad therapeutic applications are not experimentally substantiated in this abstract.

records.title: Non-Catalytic Roles of the Topoisomerase IIα C-Terminal Domain.
records.note: The article summarizes noncatalytic topoisomerase IIα functions, especially SUMO-dependent recruitment of mitotic regulators. No intervention or functional rescue is reported.
records.uncertainty: Primary efficacy evidence cannot be inferred from the mechanistic summary.

records.title: Integrated Analysis of the lncRNA-Associated ceRNA Network in Wilms Tumor via TARGET and GEO Databases.
records.note: An RNA interaction network identified expression differences and survival-associated RNAs in Wilms tumors. The abstract contains no intervention experiment.
records.uncertainty: Network associations do not demonstrate a useful compensatory drug.

records.title: Genetic Testing and Analysis in Breast Cancer Patients in Greece.
records.note: Genetic testing identified pathogenic variants and informed familial screening. No treatment-response experiment is included.
records.uncertainty: Suggested management implications do not constitute efficacy evidence.

records.title: Gene Expression Profiling of the Liver and Lung in Mice After Exposure to ZnO Quantum Dots.
records.note: ZnO quantum-dot exposure changed expression pathways consistent with inflammation in lung and liver. The exposure was assessed for toxicity.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic benefit or checkpoint compensation was tested.

records.title: Human Mps1 kinase is required for the spindle assembly checkpoint but not for centrosome duplication.
records.note: Mps1 inhibition by antibody or siRNA prevented spindle-checkpoint arrest while allowing cell division. This identifies a checkpoint requirement rather than a compensatory intervention.
records.uncertainty: The depolymerizing drug is unnamed and no rescue outcome is reported.

records.title: A putative homologue of CDC20/CDH1 in the malaria parasite is essential for male gamete development.
records.note: Deleting parasite CDC20 blocked male gamete nuclear division while sparing asexual blood-stage mitosis. The result is organism-specific mitotic biology.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or mammalian functional rescue was evaluated.

records.title: New Perspectives in Different Gene Expression Profiles for Early and Locally Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Stem Cells.
records.model: NSCLC tumor stem-cell populations from 22 patients
records.note: Recurrence-associated transcripts were enriched in selected tumor stem-cell populations. The study nominated targets without perturbing them.
records.uncertainty: Gene-expression differences cannot establish drug efficacy.

records.title: Temporal Identification of Dysregulated Genes and Pathways in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Based on Systematic Tracking of Disrupted Modules.
records.note: Stage-specific network analyses identified altered genes and metabolic or cell-cycle pathways. No therapeutic intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: The proposed markers and pathways remain associative.

records.title: KIF2C/MCAK a prognostic biomarker and its oncogenic potential in malignant progression, and prognosis of cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis as biomarker.
records.model: Cancer KIF2C expression and survival literature
records.note: High KIF2C expression correlated with poorer cancer survival in pooled studies, alongside a review of its broader functions. This is useful context for dosage risks but no direct intervention result.
records.uncertainty: The review cannot serve as independent replication of therapeutic efficacy.

records.title: Aurora B controls anaphase onset and error-free chromosome segregation in trypanosomes.
records.note: KKT14 manipulations changed arrest timing, and outer-kinetochore targeting of Aurora B promoted exit while causing extensive missegregation. Mitotic progression therefore did not imply fidelity in this parasite system.
records.uncertainty: The Aurora B inhibitor is unnamed and mammalian applicability is untested.

records.title: Comprehensive genomic analysis of rhabdomyosarcoma reveals a landscape of alterations affecting a common genetic axis in fusion-positive and fusion-negative tumors.
records.note: Sequencing identified recurrent alterations and a common signaling axis potentially amenable to treatment. No drug efficacy was measured.
records.uncertainty: Genomically suggested interventions remain untested in the saved abstract.

records.title: Suppressing Anaphase-Promoting Complex/Cyclosome-Cell Division Cycle 20 Activity to Enhance the Effectiveness of Anti-Cancer Drugs That Induce Multipolar Mitotic Spindles.
records.note: The article proposes partial APC/C-CDC20 suppression to prolong correction time, potentially sparing healthy cells during spindle-directed chemotherapy. Paclitaxel, eribulin, and vinorelbine are discussed but no new administration experiment is reported.
records.uncertainty: The claimed protective window is a hypothesis requiring primary efficacy evidence.

records.title: Clinical Relevance of Secreted Small Noncoding RNAs in an Embryo Implantation Potential Prediction at Morula and Blastocyst Development Stages.
records.model: IVF embryos and spent culture media
records.note: Secreted small RNAs were used to construct embryo implantation prediction models. This is a biomarker study without treatment efficacy.
records.uncertainty: High reported prediction accuracy does not show functional rescue.

records.title: Pathways of aging: comparative analysis of gene signatures in replicative senescence and stress induced premature senescence.
records.model: Replicative and stress-induced senescent human fibroblasts
records.note: Reanalysis distinguished stress-associated and replicative senescence pathways and nominated regulatory genes. No protective intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: Causal modulation and functional benefit remain unknown.

records.title: NAD<sup>+</sup> in Aging: Molecular Mechanisms and Translational Implications.
records.note: The review discusses NAD maintenance as a strategy for metabolic, neuronal, and muscle protection. It provides no named administered precursor or independent efficacy experiment in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: This cannot independently replicate niacin or other NAD-precursor benefits.

records.title: Phase separation drives decision making in cell division.
records.note: The review relates biomolecular condensation to spindle and centromere assembly. No intervention or efficacy result is given.
records.uncertainty: Prospective applications remain mechanistic.

records.title: Genetic Structure and Selective Signature Analysis of Xinjiang Local Sheep Populations.
records.note: Genome scans associated breed adaptation and growth with candidate loci. No therapeutic agent or functional rescue was examined.
records.uncertainty: Selection signatures do not establish treatment effects.

records.title: Random chromosome distribution in the first meiosis of F1 disomic substitution line 2R(2D) x rye hybrids (ABDR, 4× = 28) occurs without bipolar spindle assembly.
records.note: Hybrid meiocytes distributed chromosomes without a normal first-meiosis bipolar spindle, followed by apparently normal second-meiosis spindles. This is plant cytology rather than drug efficacy.
records.uncertainty: No rescue perturbation or mammalian application is reported.

records.title: SoMaCX: a complex generative genome modeling framework.
records.model: Simulated somatic and germline structural variation
records.note: SoMaCX generates complex genomes for benchmarking variation detection. It does not test an intervention in cells or organisms.
records.uncertainty: Simulation performance is unrelated to therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Emerging role of senescent microglia in brain aging-related neurodegenerative diseases.
records.note: The review proposes senescent microglia as contributors to neurodegeneration and possible intervention targets. No named senolytic or new treatment result is presented.
records.uncertainty: A proposed compensation target is not an independent efficacy experiment.

records.title: Exploring the mechanism and therapeutic potential of BUB1 in regulating esophageal cancer progression based on 5-FU target prediction.
records.model: KYSE150 and TE1 esophageal cancer cells
records.note: Although framed around predicted 5-FU targets, the validation used BUB1 siRNA, reducing colony formation and migration. The abstract does not establish 5-FU administration or BUB1B rescue.
records.uncertainty: Drug efficacy cannot be assigned from target prediction and BUB1 depletion.

records.title: Identification of potential therapeutic target genes and miRNAs for primary myelofibrosis with microarray analysis.
records.note: Differential RNA and pathway analysis nominated candidate genes and microRNAs for myelofibrosis. No intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: The therapeutic suggestions are based on associations.

records.title: TIP5 primes prostate luminal cells for the oncogenic transformation mediated by PTEN-loss.
records.model: Mouse prostate organoids with Pten loss
records.note: TIP5 was required for initiation of Pten-loss-driven transformation but dispensable after transformation. This identifies a cancer-stage dependence without a drug experiment.
records.uncertainty: No healthy-tissue compensation or chromosome-fidelity rescue was shown.

records.title: Exposure to podophyllotoxin inhibits oocyte meiosis by disturbing meiotic spindle formation.
records.note: Podophyllotoxin impaired maturation, spindle organization, chromosome alignment, and subsequent embryo development. Even exposed oocytes reaching metaphase II retained defects.
records.uncertainty: Exposure-response translation to clinical use or MVA tissue is not established.

records.title: Gene expression profiles analysis identifies a novel two-gene signature to predict overall survival in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
records.note: CDC20 and PTGDS expression formed a prognostic signature, with CDC20 methylation also associated with survival. No perturbation was tested.
records.uncertainty: Prognostic markers do not establish a useful treatment direction.

records.title: Gene expression profiling of ovarian cancer reveals candidate diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers: An integrated bioinformatics approach.
records.note: Integrated expression analyses nominated diagnostic and prognostic markers including TRIP13. The study reports no agent administration or functional rescue.
records.uncertainty: Candidates require experimental causal validation.

records.title: Proteomic Findings in Melanoma.
records.note: The article reviews proteomic contributions to melanoma biomarkers and drug-response understanding. No specific independent drug experiment appears in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: Review coverage is not efficacy replication.

records.title: Phosphorylation of microtubule-binding protein Hec1 by mitotic kinase Aurora B specifies spindle checkpoint kinase Mps1 signaling at the kinetochore.
records.note: Phosphomimetic Hec1 increased checkpoint activation while phosphorylation coupled weakened microtubule binding to greater Mps1 recruitment. This establishes a signaling switch rather than a demonstrated functional rescue.
records.uncertainty: No compound, BUB1B-deficient rescue, or improved viability endpoint is reported.

records.title: Spindle poisons and cell fate: a tale of two pathways.
records.note: Paclitaxel and vinblastine are discussed as examples of arrest-inducing anticancer drugs with variable cellular responses. The article reviews death pathways without a new dosing experiment.
records.uncertainty: Reviewed tumor killing does not demonstrate compensatory benefit.

records.title: Nuclear poly(A)-binding protein 1 is an ATM target and essential for DNA double-strand break repair.
records.note: PABPN1 depletion or loss of an ATM phosphorylation site impaired double-strand-break repair and increased sensitivity to damaging agents. The result identifies a necessary repair component.
records.uncertainty: Damage agents are unnamed and no protective compound or restoration intervention is shown.

records.title: Learning about cancer from frogs: analysis of mitotic spindles in Xenopus egg extracts.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts and spindle biology
records.note: The review explains how egg extracts identify conserved spindle factors and cancer-associated changes. It presents no specific administered-agent rescue result.
records.uncertainty: Methods and literature summaries cannot count as independent efficacy evidence.

records.title: Genetic and epigenetic features of bilateral Wilms tumor predisposition in patients from the Children's Oncology Group AREN18B5-Q.
records.note: Sequencing and methylation analysis characterized inherited and postzygotic routes to bilateral Wilms tumor. No therapeutic experiment was conducted.
records.uncertainty: Predisposition findings do not indicate drug benefit.

records.title: Identification and Validation of a Potential Stemness-Associated Biomarker in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma datasets and tumor-repopulating cells
records.note: BUB1 expression correlated with stemness and poor survival and was elevated in enriched tumor-repopulating cells. No BUB1 perturbation or drug treatment was reported.
records.uncertainty: The proposed target is BUB1 rather than BUB1B and remains an efficacy hypothesis.

records.title: Sequential Cdk1 and Plk1 phosphorylation of protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B promotes mitotic cell death.
records.note: Sequential Cdk1 and Plk1 phosphorylation activated PTP1B and promoted mitotic death, enhanced by microtubule-targeting agents. Genetic residue changes altered this death response.
records.uncertainty: The microtubule agents and kinase inhibitors are unnamed and the endpoint is tumor killing.

records.title: Mechanisms of Functional Pleiotropy of p73 in Cancer and Beyond.
records.note: The review links p73 isoforms and binding partners to diverse developmental and tumor functions. It contains no administered treatment or compensation result.
records.uncertainty: Isoform-specific effects make a general treatment direction uncertain.

records.title: Gene co-expression in the interactome: moving from correlation toward causation via an integrated approach to disease module discovery.
records.model: Human interactome and disease expression networks
records.note: Combining coexpression with protein interactions nominated disease modules and relationships. The work does not test therapeutic interventions.
records.uncertainty: Network proximity does not establish causation or treatment benefit.

records.title: Bcl-2 is a critical mediator of intestinal transformation.
records.model: Mouse and human intestinal stem cells and Apc-loss transformation
records.note: Bcl-2 supported radiation resistance in intestinal stem cells but also enabled oncogenic clone growth after Apc loss. Loss or inhibition reduced transformation, creating a protection-versus-tumor-risk tradeoff.
records.uncertainty: The inhibitor is unnamed and direct benefit in chromosome-instability disease is untested.

records.title: Ploidy influences cellular responses to gross chromosomal rearrangements in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
records.model: Haploid and diploid Saccharomyces cerevisiae with rearrangements
records.note: Rearranged yeast genomes produced physiological stress and ploidy-dependent responses in translation and proteasome pathways. No intervention improved growth or function.
records.uncertainty: Adaptive signatures alone do not identify a validated drug strategy.

records.title: Neuronal aneuploidy in health and disease: a cytomic approach to understand the molecular individuality of neurons.
records.note: The abstract describes cytometric approaches to neuronal aneuploidy and heterogeneity. It reports no protective intervention.
records.uncertainty: The relation of observed neuronal variation to a treatment response remains unspecified.

records.title: Two LXXLL motifs in the N terminus of Mps1 are required for Mps1 nuclear import during G(2)/M transition and sustained spindle checkpoint responses.
records.note: Mps1 nuclear-import mutants initiated but could not sustain nocodazole arrest, with premature Mps1 degradation. An unnamed Mps1 inhibitor left nuclear import intact.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological rescue of sustained checkpoint activity was demonstrated.

records.title: Role and Regulatory Mechanism of circRNA_14820 in the Proliferation and Differentiation of Goat Skeletal Muscle Satellite Cells.
records.note: Circ_14820 overexpression expanded satellite-cell proliferation while suppressing differentiation. This is a mixed cellular effect rather than demonstrated muscle regeneration benefit.
records.uncertainty: No compound, mature muscle function, or disease-model outcome was tested.

records.title: Genomic Features and Clinical Management of Patients with Hereditary Pancreatic Cancer Syndromes and Familial Pancreatic Cancer.
records.note: The review discusses susceptibility genes, surveillance uncertainty, and promising therapy classes. It names no individual administered drug or new efficacy experiment.
records.uncertainty: Ongoing-trial expectations are not independent treatment results.

records.title: Analysis of the different characteristics between omental preadipocytes and differentiated white adipocytes using bioinformatics methods.
records.note: Gene-expression reanalysis characterized adipocyte differentiation and suggested pathways relevant to metabolic disease. No treatment was applied or measured.
records.uncertainty: Adipogenesis as a compensation strategy remains untested here.

records.title: Bioinformatics analysis of the clinical relevance of CDCA gene family in prostate cancer.
records.note: Several CDCA-family expression levels correlated with tumor grade and relapse-free survival. No intervention or rescue endpoint was assessed.
records.uncertainty: Expression associations cannot define therapeutic direction.

records.title: Numerous Serine/Threonine Kinases Affect Blood Cell Homeostasis in Drosophila melanogaster.
records.note: Kinase overexpression and depletion broadly altered crystal-cell numbers. The screen suggests complex stress-responsive regulation without a specific beneficial treatment.
records.uncertainty: No administered compound or mammalian functional endpoint is supplied.

records.title: Next-generation transcriptome sequencing of the premenopausal breast epithelium using specimens from a normal human breast tissue bank.
records.model: Normal breast epithelium from 20 premenopausal donors
records.note: Menstrual phase and hormonal contraception were associated with epithelial expression profiles. This is physiological profiling rather than drug-efficacy testing.
records.uncertainty: Contraceptive formulations are unnamed and therapeutic benefit is not evaluated.

records.title: Nucleoporin translocated promoter region (Tpr) associates with dynein complex, preventing chromosome lagging formation during mitosis.
records.note: Tpr depletion caused lagging chromosomes and checkpoint-protein disruption, while rescue experiments tied correct segregation to dynein interaction. Excess Tpr also caused multinucleation, indicating dosage sensitivity.
records.uncertainty: The rescue is genetic and no compound or BUB1B-deficient model is described.

records.title: CENP-A reduction induces a p53-dependent cellular senescence response to protect cells from executing defective mitoses.
records.model: Primary human fibroblasts with CENP-A or p53 deficiency
records.note: CENP-A depletion induced p53-dependent senescence; removing p53 instead allowed aberrant mitosis and missegregation. Bypassing growth arrest in centromere-defective cells therefore carried a fidelity cost.
records.uncertainty: This does not test senolytics, named drugs, or BUB1B disease directly.

records.title: Effects of cranberry extracts on gene expression in THP-1 cells.
records.note: Cranberry extracts reduced LPS-associated TNF expression and induced metal-responsive genes. The evidence is mixture-level anti-inflammatory signaling rather than demonstrated tissue or chromosome rescue.
records.uncertainty: Active constituents and functional protection from oxidative damage were not established.

records.title: A dynamic transcriptomic atlas of cytokine-induced killer cells.
records.model: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells differentiating into CIK cells
records.note: Cytokine and antibody exposure generated a transcriptomic atlas of CIK-cell expansion and cytotoxic programs. Clinical safety and efficacy were inferred rather than directly demonstrated.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not establish organismal benefit or MVA compensation.

records.title: Phosphorylation of XPD drives its mitotic role independently of its DNA repair and transcription functions.
records.note: XPD/T425D and the bypass variant Eg5/S1033A restored mitotic segregation errors in XPD-mutant cells. This is a disease-relevant genetic fidelity-rescue route involving NEK6/CDK1-controlled phosphorylation.
records.uncertainty: No administered compound or BUB1B-deficient efficacy is shown.

records.title: Reanalysis of BRCA1/2 negative high risk ovarian cancer patients reveals novel germline risk loci and insights into missing heritability.
records.note: Sequencing identified known and candidate inherited cancer-risk variants. No therapeutic intervention was evaluated.
records.uncertainty: Predicted damaging variants do not establish drug responsiveness.

records.title: Case report: Successful treatment of advanced pulmonary sarcomatoid carcinoma with BUBIB-ALK rearrangement and KRAS G12C mutation by sintilimab combined with anlotinib.
records.model: Single advanced pulmonary sarcomatoid carcinoma case
records.note: Sintilimab plus anlotinib was associated with over 20 months of progression-free survival after alectinib progression and chemotherapy intolerance. This concerns a BUBIB-ALK-rearranged cancer, not constitutional BUB1B deficiency.
records.uncertainty: The uncontrolled combination case cannot isolate either drug or establish MVA benefit.

records.title: Aberrant cell cycle and apoptotic changes characterise severe influenza A infection--a meta-analysis of genomic signatures in circulating leukocytes.
records.model: Leukocytes in severe and mild influenza A
records.note: Severe infection was associated with discordant cell-cycle activation and disrupted apoptosis integration. No host-directed treatment was tested.
records.uncertainty: Expression patterns do not determine a safe compensatory intervention.

records.title: Mitotic Stress and Chromosomal Instability in Cancer: The Case for TPX2.
records.note: The review proposes that excess TPX2 and Aurora-A contribute to mitotic stress and instability. It does not report an administered-agent rescue.
records.uncertainty: Overexpression associations alone do not establish a therapeutic dose direction.

records.title: A novel genomic signature with translational significance for human idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
records.model: Bleomycin-treated rats and human lung cells
records.note: Pirfenidone attenuated CTHRC1 expression changes across fibrosis models and lung-cell challenges. The abstract emphasizes a translational marker rather than a measured improvement in lung function.
records.uncertainty: No BUB1B-related model or functional compensation endpoint is presented.

records.title: Differential expression, localization and activity of two alternatively spliced isoforms of human APC regulator CDH1.
records.model: Cultured human cells and Xenopus embryos
records.note: CDH1 isoforms differed in localization and cell-cycle effects, with CDH1α overexpression causing embryonic arrest. This identifies APC regulatory specificity without rescue efficacy.
records.uncertainty: No administered compound or beneficial organismal outcome is reported.

records.title: Tumor-reactive TCRs within exhausted TILs reveal cancer type-specific immune landscapes in renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Renal-carcinoma T cells and autologous organoids
records.note: Re-expression of selected T-cell receptors in non-exhausted T cells recovered tumor-reactive cytotoxicity in organoid assays. The work supports cancer immunotherapy development rather than chromosome-disease compensation.
records.uncertainty: Small exploratory patient numbers and absence of clinical treatment limit inference.

records.title: NET1 is a critical regulator of spindle assembly and actin dynamics in mouse oocytes.
records.note: Exogenous RAC1 rescued NET1-depletion-associated spindle, actin, and asymmetric-division defects. NET1 protected RAC1 against HACE1-mediated degradation, identifying a possible compensatory axis.
records.uncertainty: This is genetic rescue in oocytes, with no administered compound or BUB1B model.

records.title: Quantitative site-specific phosphorylation dynamics of human protein kinases during mitotic progression.
records.note: Mass spectrometry mapped changing kinase phosphorylation across mitosis. This creates candidate signaling hypotheses without a rescue experiment.
records.uncertainty: Synchronization agents are unnamed and no therapeutic outcome is reported.

records.title: The human SKA complex drives the metaphase-anaphase cell cycle transition by recruiting protein phosphatase 1 to kinetochores.
records.note: Targeting active PP1 through Ska1 fusions rescued Ska1-depletion mitotic defects; catalytically dead PP1 failed and acted dominantly negative. This establishes spatial PP1 recruitment as a compensatory mechanism.
records.uncertainty: The genetic rescue promotes anaphase in Ska deficiency and does not demonstrate safety or efficacy in BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: De Novo Mutations in CHAMP1 Cause Intellectual Disability with Severe Speech Impairment.
records.note: De novo disruptive CHAMP1 variants were associated with intellectual disability and developmental impairment. The study implicates kinetochore attachment in neurodevelopment but tests no treatment.
records.uncertainty: Predicted molecular consequences do not establish a rescuable intervention.

records.title: The Role of Long Noncoding RNAs in Intestinal Health and Diseases: A Focus on the Intestinal Barrier.
records.note: The review surveys lncRNAs in intestinal barrier integrity and proposes therapeutic applications. No individual intervention experiment is described.
records.uncertainty: Literature synthesis supplies no independent functional replication.

records.title: Identification of candidate genes that may contribute to the metastasis of prostate cancer by bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Localized and metastatic prostate cancer datasets
records.note: Expression and network analyses nominated metastasis biomarkers and cell-cycle modules. No compounds were administered.
records.uncertainty: The small discovery dataset and unvalidated targets do not support efficacy claims.

records.title: Transcriptional Diversity in Response to Aging Across Skeletal Muscles.
records.model: Young and aged mouse skeletal muscles
records.note: Muscle-specific aging maps identified differential metabolic vulnerability and EGF/EGFR involvement in inflammation. No named treatment or improvement in muscle function is reported.
records.uncertainty: The validation method and whether it restored function are unspecified.

records.title: Integrative approach to sporadic Alzheimer's disease: deficiency of TYROBP in a tauopathy mouse model reduces C1q and normalizes clinical phenotype while increasing spread and state of phosphorylation of tau.
records.model: MAPT-P301S tauopathy mice with Tyrobp deletion
records.note: Tyrobp deficiency improved learning and synaptic function while reducing C1q despite increased tau phosphorylation and spread. This provides a concrete compensation example where function improves without correcting the upstream pathology.
records.uncertainty: C1q causality and pharmacological translation require testing outside this genetic tauopathy model.

records.title: Current Understanding on Why Ovarian Cancer Is Resistant to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors.
records.note: The review discusses modest checkpoint-inhibitor response rates and mechanisms of ovarian-cancer resistance. No specific new administered regimen is tested.
records.uncertainty: Pooled literature discussion is not independent efficacy evidence.

records.title: Understanding the Underlying Molecular Mechanisms of Meiotic Arrest during In Vitro Spermatogenesis in Rat Prepubertal Testicular Tissue.
records.note: All three tested anti-inflammatory molecules failed to promote meiosis despite inflammatory transcriptomic signals. Barrier and steroidogenic defects remained plausible contributors.
records.uncertainty: The three agents are unnamed, so their identities and tested exposures need primary followup.

records.title: LncRNA ZFHX4-AS1 as a novel biomarker in adrenocortical carcinoma.
records.note: ZFHX4-AS1 knockdown reduced cancer-cell proliferation and migration, consistent with its prognostic association. No drug or nonmalignant functional rescue was tested.
records.uncertainty: Tumor growth suppression does not establish MVA compensation.

records.title: Separase and Roads to Disengage Sister Chromatids during Anaphase.
records.note: The article reviews how separase timing coordinates cohesion removal with spindle assembly. No new therapeutic intervention is presented.
records.uncertainty: Regulatory mechanisms alone do not provide a validated compensation strategy.

records.title: Identification of Hub of the Hub-Genes From Different Individual Studies for Early Diagnosis, Prognosis, and Therapies of Breast Cancer.
records.model: Breast-cancer hub-gene networks and docking simulations
records.note: The study ranked ten named candidate drugs using docking and selected-complex simulations. None is reported administered in the saved abstract.
records.uncertainty: Predicted binding and stability do not demonstrate efficacy or rescue.

records.title: Targeting mitotic pathways for endocrine-related cancer therapeutics.
records.note: The review surveys mitotic targets and limitations of spindle poisons in cancer therapy. No specific new dosing or rescue experiment is provided.
records.uncertainty: A therapeutic-target catalog does not establish compensation efficacy.

records.title: The Clathrin-dependent Spindle Proteome.
records.note: Clathrin depletion changed the spindle proteome and phosphorylation, supporting roles in stabilization and bipolar assembly. No restoration intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: The abstract identifies mechanistic dependencies rather than a therapeutic agent.

records.title: Stem and progenitor cells in myelodysplastic syndromes show aberrant stage-specific expansion and harbor genetic and epigenetic alterations.
records.model: MDS stem/progenitor cells and one longitudinally treated patient
records.note: Abnormal stem cells persisted during morphologic remission after 5-azacytidine, and clonal expansion preceded relapse. The study cautions that clinical appearance of remission need not normalize the abnormal stem-cell compartment.
records.uncertainty: This single treatment trajectory does not assess constitutional chromosome-instability disease.

records.title: Systematic Analysis of Differential Expression Profile in Rheumatoid Arthritis Chondrocytes Using Next-Generation Sequencing and Bioinformatics Approaches.
records.note: RNA profiling identified inflammatory and cell-cycle abnormalities and a proposed miR-140-3p–FGF9 interaction. No intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: Potential cartilage targets remain causally unvalidated.

records.title: Effects of small particle numbers on long-term behaviour in discrete biochemical systems.
records.note: The study develops theory for molecular-number effects on stable biochemical states, with a checkpoint-model example. No biological drug efficacy was measured.
records.uncertainty: Model behavior is not a demonstrated functional rescue.

records.title: Construction of a ceRNA Network and Comprehensive Analysis of lncRNA in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma datasets and clinical samples
records.note: A ceRNA network and RNA signatures were associated with HCC survival and validated for expression. No drug or rescue experiment is described.
records.uncertainty: Expression validation does not establish treatment efficacy.

records.title: Gametic specialization of centromeric histone paralogs in Drosophila virilis.
records.note: Centromeric histone paralogs showed sex-specific retention and replacement across reproduction. The study explains specialization without testing treatment.
records.uncertainty: No drug or disease-model rescue is present.

records.title: Gamma synuclein is a novel Twist1 target that promotes TGF-β-induced cancer cell migration and invasion.
records.note: SNCG knockdown blocked TGF-β/Twist1-driven migration and metastasis. TGF-β was a disease-promoting challenge, not a rescue agent.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic compound or nonmalignant functional compensation was demonstrated.

records.title: Efficacy of pembrolizumab and comprehensive CD274/PD-L1 profiles in patients previously treated with chemoradiation therapy as radical treatment in bladder cancer.
records.note: Pembrolizumab outcomes were similar after prior chemoradiation or cystectomy in matched groups. The comparison concerns oncology response rather than chromosome-fidelity restoration.
records.uncertainty: Retrospective treatment-history comparisons do not establish MVA efficacy.

records.title: Identification of Prognostic Biomarkers of Glioblastoma Based on Multidatabase Integration and Its Correlation with Immune-Infiltration Cells.
records.note: TIMP1 expression associated with poor prognosis, and depletion reduced glioblastoma proliferation and invasion. No administered drug was evaluated.
records.uncertainty: Cancer-cell suppression is not evidence of healthy-tissue compensation.

records.title: The dynactin complex maintains the integrity of metaphasic centrosomes to ensure transition to anaphase.
records.model: Human cells with dynactin component knockdown
records.note: Depleting dynactin p24 damaged metaphase centrosome integrity and produced abnormal alignment and death, with milder outcomes after p150 depletion. No rescue experiment is reported.
records.uncertainty: Component-specific defects do not identify an effective drug.

records.title: Cell cycle arrest and the evolution of chronic kidney disease from acute kidney injury.
records.model: Acute kidney injury and chronic fibrosis
records.note: The review links sustained tubular G2/M arrest to profibrotic secretion and maladaptive repair. Arrested cells are proposed as targets without a named tested intervention.
records.uncertainty: Primary studies are needed to distinguish arrest release from safe functional recovery.

records.title: Requirements for NuMA in maintenance and establishment of mammalian spindle poles.
records.note: Loss of mitotic NuMA impaired spindle-pole focusing and centrosome attachment under tension. Combined absence of NuMA and centrosomes abolished initial focusing.
records.uncertainty: No compound or compensatory restoration was tested.

records.title: Self-regulated mechanism of Plk1 localization to kinetochores: lessons from the Plk1-PBIP1 interaction.
records.note: The abstract explains PLK1 self-recruitment and subsequent partner exchange at kinetochores. It does not present a treatment or rescue endpoint.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic localization control alone cannot establish therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Escaping from CRISPR-Cas-mediated knockout: the facts, mechanisms, and applications.
records.note: The review warns that residual proteins can make apparent knockout phenotypes misleading and discusses applications. It reports no specific chromosome-disease treatment result.
records.uncertainty: A knockout-based rescue claim would still require confirmation of residual function.

records.title: Cross-Species Transcriptomic and Network Analysis of Human and Canine Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma Identifies a Conserved Replication-DNA Damage Module for Drug Repurposing.
records.model: Human and canine diffuse large B-cell lymphoma datasets
records.note: Network analysis nominated topoisomerase poisons and rucaparib, while module scores associated with outcomes in CHOP-treated dogs. The nominated individual compounds were not experimentally administered in this abstract.
records.uncertainty: Computational reversal scores do not establish efficacy of the proposed candidates.

records.title: Disruption to schizophrenia-associated gene Fez1 in the hippocampus of HDAC11 knockout mice.
records.model: Hdac11-null mouse brain and neural precursor cells
records.note: HDAC11 loss left gross morphology and precursor behavior apparently normal but reduced hippocampal Fez1 expression. The effects were age- and region-dependent.
records.uncertainty: No HDAC11 inhibitor or functional neurological deficit was directly tested.

records.title: Rewiring macrophage immunometabolism in gouty arthritis: from metabolic checkpoints to intelligent nano-delivery.
records.note: The review proposes metabolic and nanoparticle approaches to inflammatory macrophage regulation. No named administered intervention or independent efficacy experiment is provided.
records.uncertainty: Proposed metabolic reprogramming requires direct functional validation.

records.title: ARHGEF17 sets the timer for retention of Mps1 at kinetochores.
records.note: The commentary describes a separate study of ARHGEF17-dependent Mps1 kinetochore retention. It supplies no independent drug or rescue result.
records.uncertainty: The cited primary work is needed to assess actionable compensation.

records.title: MAD2 Combined with Mitotic Spindle Apparatus (MSA) and Anticentromere Antibody (ACA) for Diagnosis of Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC).
records.model: Small-cell lung cancer and comparison patients
records.note: MAD2 expression combined with autoantibody measurements improved diagnostic discrimination. No treatment was administered as an experimental intervention.
records.uncertainty: Diagnostic sensitivity does not establish therapeutic usefulness.

records.title: Transcriptional recapitulation and subversion of embryonic colon development by mouse colon tumor models and human colon cancer.
records.model: Human colorectal cancers and mouse tumors/development
records.note: Cross-species expression patterns showed reactivation of embryonic programs and loss of suppressor modules in tumors. The abstract proposes combinatorial targets without testing therapies.
records.uncertainty: Expression similarity cannot establish drug benefit.

records.title: Multi-omics profiling reveals dysregulated ribosome biogenesis and impaired cell proliferation following knockout of CDR2L.
records.note: CDR2L knockout disrupted ribosome-related and cell-cycle expression and reduced proliferation. No administered treatment or healthy-cell rescue was evaluated.
records.uncertainty: The findings do not establish the mechanism of neuronal degeneration or its treatment.

records.title: Integrative transcriptomics and single-cell analysis identify SIX4 as a candidate epithelial target in ovarian cancer and PCOS-associated ovarian dysregulation.
records.model: KGN and SKOV3 cells plus ovarian transcriptomic datasets
records.note: DHEA increased SIX4 expression, and SIX4 knockdown suppressed ovarian-cancer growth and migration. A benzbromarone-related scaffold was assessed computationally only.
records.uncertainty: Docking must not be interpreted as administered benzbromarone efficacy.

records.title: High Throughput mRNA Sequencing Reveals Potential Therapeutic Targets of Tao-Hong-Si-Wu Decoction in Experimental Middle Cerebral Artery Occlusion.
records.note: The decoction reversed subsets of stroke-associated expression changes and nominated pathways; neurological improvement is cited as prior background. The tested preparation is a mixture.
records.uncertainty: This abstract does not isolate active constituents or report a new functional improvement magnitude.

records.title: Mitotic regulation of the anaphase-promoting complex.
records.note: The review describes Nup98/Rae1 control of securin degradation and APC/C timing. No drug or independent rescue experiment is presented.
records.uncertainty: Temporal regulation mechanisms do not themselves establish an effective treatment.

records.title: Checkpoint Kinase 1 Is a Key Signal Transducer of DNA Damage in the Early Mammalian Cleavage Embryo.
records.note: The review focuses on Chk1 as a DNA-integrity transducer in early embryogenesis. It reports no specific administered intervention.
records.uncertainty: An embryo checkpoint role is not efficacy evidence.

records.title: Nakiterpiosin targets tubulin and triggers mitotic catastrophe in human cancer cells.
records.model: Human cancer cells including paclitaxel-resistant cells
records.note: Nakiterpiosin disrupted microtubules, impaired bipolar spindles, and induced mitotic catastrophe. Activity against resistant cancer cells reflects cytotoxicity rather than improved chromosome fidelity.
records.uncertainty: Paclitaxel resistance is model context, and no protective treatment outcome was shown.

records.title: Examining the key genes and pathways in hepatocellular carcinoma development from hepatitis B virus‑positive cirrhosis.
records.model: HBV cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma datasets
records.note: Mitotic genes were upregulated during cancer progression and associated with poorer survival. No intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: Candidate biomarker status does not demonstrate compensation efficacy.

records.title: Quantitative mass spectrometry analysis reveals similar substrate consensus motif for human Mps1 kinase and Plk1.
records.model: Human Mps1 kinase in cells and in vitro assays
records.note: Phosphorylation mapping showed Mps1 autophosphorylation and regulation by Aurora B and other kinases. The work identifies signaling relationships without a rescue endpoint.
records.uncertainty: No named administered compound or disease-model benefit is described.

records.title: Decoding protein methylation function with thermal stability analysis.
records.note: Thermal-stability profiling linked PRMT5 and EZH2 to RNA-binding and mitotic protein functions. It provides a functional mapping resource rather than treatment efficacy.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered agent or compensatory result is reported.

records.title: Mechanisms underlying Plk1 polo-box domain-mediated biological processes and their physiological significance.
records.note: The review compares mechanisms that recruit PLK1 to phosphorylated partners during mitosis. No administered treatment or independent rescue result is supplied.
records.uncertainty: Binding mechanisms alone do not identify a beneficial pharmacological direction.

records.title: ALKBH5 controls the meiosis-coupled mRNA clearance in oocytes by removing the N <sup>6</sup>-methyladenosine methylation.
records.note: Reducing the RNA reader IGF2BP2 partially rescued defects caused by ALKBH5 loss and persistent maternal RNA stabilization. This nominates a compensatory RNA-clearance pathway.
records.uncertainty: The rescue is genetic and does not establish a compound or BUB1B-disease benefit.

records.title: Emerging insights in senescence: pathways from preclinical models to therapeutic innovations.
records.note: The review describes senescent-cell heterogeneity and therapeutic opportunities while recognizing both homeostatic and pathogenic roles. No new administered treatment result is included.
records.uncertainty: Review-level claims cannot count as independent efficacy replication.

records.title: Kinetochore structure and spindle assembly checkpoint signaling in the budding yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
records.model: Budding yeast and conserved spindle checkpoints
records.note: The review discusses kinetochore control, tension sensing, and checkpoint outputs beyond APC/C inhibition. No new drug or rescue experiment is presented.
records.uncertainty: Conserved pathway discussion does not demonstrate a treatment effect.

records.title: The roles of Fzy/Cdc20 and Fzr/Cdh1 in regulating the destruction of cyclin B in space and time.
records.note: Cyclin B mutants and APC activator localization distinguished spindle-localized and later cytoplasmic destruction. The work explains checkpoint timing without therapeutic testing.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological or disease-model rescue is shown.

records.title: Arabidopsis KNL1 recruits type one protein phosphatase to kinetochores to silence the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.note: Disrupting KNL1 recruitment of phosphatases caused sustained checkpoint activation, metaphase arrest, and plant growth defects. Correct silencing is necessary as well as activation.
records.uncertainty: This plant mechanism is not a demonstrated mammalian intervention.

records.title: Human fibroblasts facilitate the generation of iPSCs-derived mammary-like organoids.
records.model: iPSC-derived mammary-like organoids and NSG mice
records.note: Fibroblast coculture improved organoid branching and mammary-like structure formation after transplantation. The intervention is cellular tissue engineering, not a named drug.
records.uncertainty: No checkpoint deficiency or systemic functional rescue was tested.

records.title: The phospho-dependent role of BRCA2 on the maintenance of chromosome integrity.
records.note: The review discusses mitotic functions of BRCA2 and DNA-repair proteins beyond their interphase roles. No new drug or rescue experiment is reported.
records.uncertainty: The molecular summary cannot establish pharmacological efficacy.

records.title: Molecular basis of the association between transcription regulators nuclear respiratory factor 1 and inhibitor of DNA binding protein 3 and the development of microvascular lesions.
records.note: NRF1 and ID3 are proposed as vascular-disease targets based on growth, senescence, and repair roles. The abstract contains no tested therapeutic agent.
records.uncertainty: Target proposals do not demonstrate functional compensation.

records.title: Establishment of liver tumor cell lines from atherogenic and high fat diet fed hepatitis C virus transgenic mice.
records.model: Syngeneic mouse liver tumors derived from HCV-transgenic mice
records.note: New liver-cancer lines differed in response to an anti-PD1 antibody, with a stem-like resistant model. The study establishes oncology models.
records.uncertainty: The antibody identity is unnamed and no MVA-related rescue is tested.

records.title: Stochastic competition between mechanistically independent slippage and death pathways determines cell fate during mitotic arrest.
records.model: Single cells undergoing prolonged mitotic arrest
records.note: zVAD-fmk blocked death while Cdc20 depletion blocked slippage, supporting independent competing fate pathways. Survival or mitotic escape was not shown to restore chromosome segregation.
records.uncertainty: The arrest-inducing agents are unnamed and no lasting functional benefit is reported.

records.title: Transcriptome profiling of granulosa cells from bovine ovarian follicles during atresia.
records.note: Follicular atresia involved cell-death and fibrotic expression programs compared with healthy follicles. No intervention was administered.
records.uncertainty: Correlated remodeling pathways do not establish a treatment target.

records.title: Inactivating the spindle checkpoint kinase Bub1 during embryonic development results in a global shutdown of proliferation.
records.model: Mouse embryos with Bub1 loss at E10.5
records.note: Embryonic Bub1 inactivation rapidly shut down proliferation and caused widespread apoptosis and hemorrhage. This provides direct developmental counterevidence to broadly suppressing a core checkpoint component.
records.uncertainty: Bub1 is distinct from BubR1/BUB1B and genetic null effects do not define inhibitor dose tolerability.

records.title: The oncogenic role of TRIP13 in regulating proliferation, invasion, and cell cycle checkpoint in NSCLC cells.
records.note: TRIP13 knockdown reduced cancer-cell proliferation and invasion and altered mitotic-checkpoint-complex behavior with metaphase arrest. No small molecule was tested.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not show improved segregation or deficient-checkpoint compensation.

records.title: DAPPER: a data-mining resource for protein-protein interactions.
records.note: DAPPER integrates protein-interaction experiments into a searchable resource. It supplies no intervention efficacy result.
records.uncertainty: Database utility is not biological rescue evidence.

records.title: ZW10: an emerging orchestrator of organelle dynamics during the cell division cycle.
records.note: The review highlights ZW10 roles in membrane trafficking and chromosome segregation. No administered compound or functional rescue is described.
records.uncertainty: Its mechanistic roles remain distinct from a validated treatment.

records.title: The Protein Acetylation after Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: Mechanisms and Therapeutic Opportunities.
records.model: Protein acetylation in spinal cord injury
records.note: The review discusses αTAT1, HDAC6, and SIRT2 modulation as possible regeneration approaches. The abstract names no individual administered agent or new recovery experiment.
records.uncertainty: Primary efficacy and target-specific tradeoffs require separate evaluation.

records.title: A five-m6A regulatory gene signature is a prognostic biomarker in lung adenocarcinoma patients.
records.note: An m6A gene signature associated with risk and checkpoint-therapy response. No named inhibitor or controlled rescue experiment is provided.
records.uncertainty: Response association cannot be translated into chromosome-disease compensation.

records.title: Pan-cancer network disorders revealed by overall and local signaling entropy.
records.note: Signaling entropy correlated with stemness, malignancy, prognosis, and drug-response patterns. No intervention was tested for functional rescue.
records.uncertainty: Prediction performance cannot be interpreted as efficacy.

records.title: Urothelial Cancer Associated 1 (UCA1) and miR-193 Are Two Non-coding RNAs Involved in Trophoblast Fusion and Placental Diseases.
records.note: UCA1 knockdown disrupted the expression program associated with trophoblast fusion; STOX1B abundance alleviated parts of its forskolin-response effect. Forskolin served as a differentiation stimulus.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not demonstrate restored placental function or drug benefit in disease.

records.title: Identification of heat shock factor 1 molecular and cellular targets during embryonic and adult female meiosis.
records.note: HSF1 loss disrupted meiotic gene programs and chromosome structures, and spindle-checkpoint inhibition bypassed metaphase arrest. Bypass did not establish correction of the underlying abnormalities.
records.uncertainty: The checkpoint inhibitor is unnamed and functional developmental rescue is not shown.

records.title: Genetic Alterations of NF-κB and Its Regulators: A Rich Platform to Advance Colorectal Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment.
records.model: NF-κB alterations and colorectal cancer models
records.note: The review proposes NF-κB pathway alterations and patient-derived models as platforms for therapy discovery. No new named treatment experiment is presented.
records.uncertainty: Genetic prevalence does not establish therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Study on the expression of TOP2A in hepatocellular carcinoma and its relationship with patient prognosis.
records.note: Integrated expression and survival analyses nominated TOP2A as an HCC marker. No inhibitor or rescue treatment was tested.
records.uncertainty: Target expression does not establish efficacy or a safe intervention direction.

records.title: Mitotic checkpoint slippage in humans occurs via cyclin B destruction in the presence of an active checkpoint.
records.note: Cells escaped nocodazole arrest through progressive cyclin B destruction despite an active checkpoint. The study separates mitotic exit from checkpoint satisfaction.
records.uncertainty: No protective compound or improved chromosome-fidelity endpoint was tested.

records.title: Acidosis-associated gene signature defines novel subtypes and dual-target therapeutic candidates in breast cancer.
records.model: Breast-cancer acidosis signatures and molecular simulations
records.note: Subtype analysis predicted drug sensitivity and docking nominated four leads for CCNA2/CDC45. No lead compound is reported administered.
records.uncertainty: Predicted binding and simulated response do not show functional efficacy.

records.title: Structural bases of signal generation and transduction by the SPS amino acid sensor of Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
records.note: Mutations and structural predictions mapped receptor and phosphatase control of amino-acid sensing. The work does not test a disease rescue intervention.
records.uncertainty: No named administered nutrient or drug efficacy is reported.

records.title: Mitotic Origins of Chromosomal Instability in Colorectal Cancer.
records.note: The abstract summarizes mitotic defects contributing to colorectal-cancer instability. No therapeutic experiment is described.
records.uncertainty: A broad mechanism overview supplies no independent efficacy result.

records.title: Transcription of the 1.688 satellite DNA family is under the control of RNA interference machinery in Drosophila melanogaster ovaries.
records.note: Spn-E mutation increased satellite transcription and active chromatin marks, supporting RNAi-mediated repeat silencing. No restoration intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: No compound or functional rescue endpoint is reported.

records.title: NMU Is a Poor Prognostic Biomarker in Patients with Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Lung adenocarcinoma datasets and in vitro validation
records.note: NMU expression and variants associated with poor prognosis and cell-cycle/cAMP signaling. The abstract gives no specific intervention or rescue result.
records.uncertainty: Proposed therapeutic targeting remains unvalidated here.

records.title: Multi-platform profiling characterizes molecular subgroups and resistance networks in chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
records.note: Molecular profiling separated instability-associated and EMT-like CLL; EMT-like cases gained less from rituximab addition. DNA damage inhibited the differentiation program.
records.uncertainty: The DNA-damaging intervention is unnamed and no chromosome-disease compensation was shown.

records.title: Mislocalization of the Drosophila centromere-specific histone CID promotes formation of functional ectopic kinetochores.
records.note: Excess CID/CENP-A formed ectopic functional kinetochores, causing fragmentation, missegregation, and organismal lethality. This is a direct caution against indiscriminately increasing centromeric histone supply.
records.uncertainty: The result concerns overexpression in flies rather than a tested human drug exposure.

records.title: Identification of biological pathways and processes regulated by NEK5 in breast epithelial cells via an integrated proteomic approach.
records.note: NEK5 overexpression increased clonogenicity and abnormal acinar growth while changing signaling and mitotic pathways. No rescue drug was administered.
records.uncertainty: A multifaceted overexpression phenotype does not establish a compensation strategy.

records.title: E2F4 function in G2: maintaining G2-arrest to prevent mitotic entry with damaged DNA.
records.note: The review describes E2F4-mediated maintenance of G2 arrest and the damage and death seen after its depletion under irradiation. It provides no independent treatment trial.
records.uncertainty: Review evidence must not be counted as replication or extrapolated to safe arrest bypass.

records.title: The WHO Classification of Genetic Tumour Syndromes: Considerations for Genetics.
records.note: The article presents a mechanism-based classification of inherited tumor syndromes. No intervention or efficacy result is reported.
records.uncertainty: Classification relationships do not establish drug responsiveness.

records.title: Identification of potential therapeutic targets in prostate cancer through a cross-species approach.
records.note: Cross-species filtering identified MELK as a cancer-cell survival dependency and recurrence-associated target. No named compound is reported administered.
records.uncertainty: The perturbation details and healthy-tissue effects are unspecified.

records.title: Expression profiling during mammary epithelial cell three-dimensional morphogenesis identifies PTPRO as a novel regulator of morphogenesis and ErbB2-mediated transformation.
records.model: MCF-10A mammary structures and ErbB2 transformation
records.note: PTPRO depletion weakened proliferation arrest and enhanced ErbB2-associated transformation, consistent with a tumor-suppressor role. No pharmacological restoration was tested.
records.uncertainty: This does not establish a compound-mediated functional rescue.

records.title: Global gene expression profiling and validation in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and its association with clinical phenotypes.
records.note: Independent RNA and protein measurements confirmed dysregulated tumor genes. No intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: Replication of expression changes is not replication of drug efficacy.

records.title: Identification of distinct gene co-expression modules and specific hub genes in skin lesions of atopic dermatitis and psoriasis by WGCNA.
records.note: Coexpression analysis identified disease-associated modules and hub genes. It offers diagnostic and mechanistic hypotheses without treatment evidence.
records.uncertainty: No agent, target perturbation, or functional recovery was demonstrated.

records.title: CEBP-β and PLK1 as Potential Mediators of the Breast Cancer/Obesity Crosstalk: In Vitro and In Silico Analyses.
records.note: Adipocyte-conditioned medium increased proliferation, motility, and invasion and induced CEBP-β/PLK1-associated programs. This is a disease-promoting mixture exposure.
records.uncertainty: The responsible constituents and therapeutic reversal were not established.

records.title: A Five-mRNA Expression Signature to Predict Survival in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma by Integrated Bioinformatic Analyses.
records.model: Oral squamous-cell carcinoma datasets and paired samples
records.note: A five-mRNA signature predicted survival and was validated for expression in paired samples. No drug efficacy experiment was performed.
records.uncertainty: A prognostic signature does not identify a validated treatment.

records.title: Forkhead box M1 regulates the transcriptional network of genes essential for mitotic progression and genes encoding the SCF (Skp2-Cks1) ubiquitin ligase.
records.model: Foxm1-null mouse fibroblasts and U2OS cells
records.note: FoxM1 loss suppressed multiple mitotic regulators and caused arrest, with premature senescence in fibroblasts. The work defines a transcriptional requirement without testing restoration.
records.uncertainty: Increasing FoxM1 or using a compound cannot be assumed beneficial from this loss-of-function experiment.

records.title: Human synthetic lethal inference as potential anti-cancer target gene detection.
records.model: Human networks inferred from yeast and cancer databases
records.note: Phylogenetic and database analysis nominated synthetic-lethal cancer targets and potential drug links. No candidate was experimentally dosed.
records.uncertainty: Inferred lethality does not establish efficacy or selectivity.

records.title: AR/ER Ratio Correlates with Expression of Proliferation Markers and with Distinct Subset of Breast Tumors.
records.note: Higher AR/ER ratios correlated with proliferation markers and aggressive tumor subtypes. No intervention was administered.
records.uncertainty: Receptor-ratio association does not establish drug responsiveness.

records.title: Could microtubule inhibitors be the best choice of therapy in gastric cancer with high immune activity: mutant DYNC1H1 as a biomarker.
records.model: Gastric cancer genomic and drug-sensitivity datasets
records.note: Database analyses proposed microtubule inhibitors for high-immune-activity gastric cancers with DYNC1H1 mutations. No specific new dosing experiment is reported.
records.uncertainty: The individual drugs are unnamed and database sensitivity is not MVA rescue evidence.

records.title: Mitotic kinases and phosphatases cooperate to shape the right response.
records.note: The abstract discusses coordinated kinase and phosphatase control of mitosis through a conceptual analogy. No intervention result is supplied.
records.uncertainty: No specific mechanism or efficacy experiment can be extracted.

records.title: High copy number variations, particular transcription factors, and low immunity contribute to the stemness of prostate cancer cells.
records.note: Stemness correlated with copy-number changes, transcription factors, and immune features, with EZH2 as a central node. No treatment was tested.
records.uncertainty: Network prominence does not establish a beneficial intervention.

records.title: Improving diagnostic precision in primary ovarian insufficiency using comprehensive genetic and autoantibody testing.
records.note: Expanded genetic and autoimmune testing increased identification of potential causes of ovarian insufficiency. This is diagnostic yield rather than therapeutic efficacy.
records.uncertainty: No treatment or restoration of fertility was evaluated.

records.title: The BUB3-BUB1 Complex Promotes Telomere DNA Replication.
records.note: Loss of BUB3-BUB1 produced fragile shortened telomeres, and BUB1 kinase activity supported TRF1/BLM recruitment during replication. This adds a nonmitotic cost to suppressing BUB1 activity.
records.uncertainty: No named compound or direct BUB1B-deficient treatment response is described.

records.title: Identification of key candidate genes and small molecule drugs in cervical cancer by bioinformatics strategy.
records.note: Expression and interaction analysis nominated genes and nine CMap small-molecule candidates. No candidate was dosed in an experiment.
records.uncertainty: The nine drugs are unnamed and predicted utility remains untested.

records.title: PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors-based treatment for advanced renal cell carcinoma: Mechanisms affecting efficacy and combination therapies.
records.note: The review discusses checkpoint antibodies and combination regimens with variable efficacy. Nivolumab, avelumab, and pembrolizumab are literature examples rather than new administered experiments here.
records.uncertainty: Review discussion cannot count as independent efficacy replication.

records.title: Integrative transcriptomics-based identification of cryptic drivers of taxol-resistance genes in ovarian carcinoma cells: Analysis of the androgen receptor.
records.note: AR silencing increased taxol sensitivity and suppressed resistance genes, whereas DHT induced those genes. Unnamed AKT and JNK inhibitors also reduced AR expression.
records.uncertainty: The beneficial endpoint is cancer killing, without evidence of healthy-cell fidelity improvement.

records.title: Elimination of p19<sup>ARF</sup>-expressing cells enhances pulmonary function in mice.
records.note: Eliminating p19ARF-expressing cells through a toxin-receptor system reversed age-associated lung hypofunction and expression changes. This is substantive tissue compensation without restoration of an upstream gene defect.
records.uncertainty: The toxin is unnamed and this engineered ablation is not evidence for a particular senolytic compound.

records.title: The Potential Genes Mediate the Pathogenicity of Allogeneic CD4<sup>+</sup>T Cell in aGVHD Mouse Model.
records.model: Mouse acute graft-versus-host disease and CD4 T cells
records.note: Transplant comparisons and cellular profiling identified immunoregulatory pathways and hub genes in graft-versus-host disease. No named therapeutic agent was tested.
records.uncertainty: Cytokine stimuli are unnamed and treatment efficacy remains unmeasured.

records.title: Dissecting novel mechanisms of hepatitis B virus related hepatocellular carcinoma using meta-analysis of public data.
records.note: Meta-analysis nominated RABL6 and HOXA10 as regulators linked to tumor biology and survival. No causal treatment experiment was performed.
records.uncertainty: Computational causal labels do not establish intervention efficacy.

records.title: Identification and Validation of Key Genes in Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma cohorts and cell lines
records.note: Five mitotic genes were associated with HCC expression and prognosis and checked by qPCR. No therapeutic intervention was performed.
records.uncertainty: Expression validation does not demonstrate drug benefit.

records.title: Ovarian Aging: Mechanisms, Age-Related Disorders, and Therapeutic Interventions.
records.note: The review covers mechanisms and broad intervention classes for ovarian aging. It supplies no individual administered-agent result.
records.uncertainty: Review synthesis cannot count as independent efficacy evidence.

records.title: A Pyranoxanthone as a Potent Antimitotic and Sensitizer of Cancer Cells to Low Doses of Paclitaxel.
records.note: Pyranoxanthone 2 caused persistent congression errors and checkpoint-dependent arrest, and enhanced paclitaxel-associated apoptosis. Its benefit is antitumor cytotoxicity, not fidelity repair.
records.uncertainty: No normal-tissue compensation or deficient-checkpoint rescue is reported.

records.title: Development and validation of an epithelial-mesenchymal transition-related gene signature for predicting prognosis.
records.note: A seven-gene EMT signature stratified survival risk and was used to discuss possible drug structures. No compound was tested experimentally.
records.uncertainty: Prognostic separation does not establish therapeutic efficacy.

records.title: Targeted proteomic approach in prostatic tissue: a panel of potential biomarkers for cancer detection.
records.note: Proteomics identified differentially expressed proteins and enriched neoplasia pathways. The work focuses on detection rather than treatment.
records.uncertainty: No intervention or functional rescue was assessed.

records.title: Bioinformatics prediction and experimental verification identify MAD2L1 and CCNB2 as diagnostic biomarkers of rhabdomyosarcoma.
records.note: Reducing MAD2L1 or CCNB2 suppressed tumor-cell growth and invasion and promoted apoptosis. This is a cancer dependency rather than restoration of checkpoint-deficient tissue function.
records.uncertainty: No drug or MVA disease-model benefit is provided.

records.title: Maize LOST SUBSIDIARY CELL encoding a large subunit of ribonucleotide reductase is required for subsidiary cell development and plant growth.
records.note: LSC deficiency reduced nucleotide supply and stomatal-cell development, while overexpression increased nucleotide synthesis and plant growth. The intervention is genetic and plant-specific.
records.uncertainty: No administered nucleotide or mammalian compensation result is shown.

records.title: Desmoplastic melanoma with sarcomatoid dedifferentiation.
records.note: Shared genomic changes supported dedifferentiation within one melanoma rather than two coincident tumors. No therapeutic treatment was evaluated.
records.uncertainty: Clonal classification gives no drug efficacy evidence.

records.title: An artificially constructed de novo human chromosome behaves almost identically to its natural counterpart during metaphase and anaphase in living cells.
records.model: Human artificial chromosomes in HT1080 cells
records.note: Artificial chromosomes aligned and segregated largely like host chromosomes despite different oscillation behavior. This validates an experimental chromosome tool.
records.uncertainty: No disease correction or administered therapeutic agent was tested.

records.title: DNA Damage Repair Classifier Defines Distinct Groups in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.note: DNA-repair expression classes associated with regeneration signatures and clinical aggressiveness. No intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: High repair-gene expression cannot be equated with a beneficial repair treatment.
