records.title: Kinetochore-microtubule attachment throughout mitosis potentiated by the elongated stalk of the kinetochore kinesin CENP-E.
records.model: CENP-E biochemical assays and cultured cells
records.note: Shortening the CENP-E stalk destabilized attachments and produced misaligned and lagging chromosomes. The study establishes structural requirements without a rescue drug.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological restoration or BUB1B-deficient functional outcome is shown.

records.title: RRM2 inhibition alters cell cycle through ATM/Rb/E2F1 pathway in atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumor.
records.model: Atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumor cells and prior in vivo tumor study
records.note: COH29 treatment induced DNA damage and ATM/Rb/E2F1-dependent arrest with impaired repair. Prior tumor-growth and survival benefits are oncology outcomes, not correction of chromosomal instability.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not establish healthy-tissue compensation or actual-MVA benefit.

records.title: Diverse effects of methylseleninic acid on the transcriptional program of human prostate cancer cells.
records.note: MSA reduced proliferation and androgen signaling while increasing phase 2 detoxification responses; no chromosome-fidelity rescue was tested.
records.uncertainty: Cancer-cell transcription and growth effects do not establish benefit in BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: Key signaling networks are dysregulated in patients with the adipose tissue disorder, lipedema.
records.note: Pharmacologic Bub1 inhibition and Bub1 depletion suppressed excessive proliferation in lipedema-derived cells.
records.uncertainty: This targets excess BUB1 signaling rather than deficient BUB1B function and does not demonstrate MVA compensation.

records.title: CENP-F expression is associated with poor prognosis and chromosomal instability in patients with primary breast cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer cohorts and tissue arrays
records.note: CENP-F expression tracked aggressive disease, chromosomal instability markers, and poorer survival.
records.uncertainty: No intervention or causal chromosome-fidelity improvement was reported.

records.title: Use of the novel Plk1 inhibitor ZK-thiazolidinone to elucidate functions of Plk1 in early and late stages of mitosis.
records.note: TAL inhibition established requirements for Plk1 in mitotic localization and successful cytokinesis.
records.uncertainty: The abstract reports mitotic interference rather than a beneficial compensation strategy.

records.title: A new assay for measuring chromosome instability (CIN) and identification of drugs that elevate CIN in cancer cells.
records.model: Cancer cells carrying an EGFP human artificial chromosome
records.note: Taxol and peloruside A caused the greatest artificial-chromosome missegregation among similarly cytotoxic compounds tested.
records.uncertainty: Cancer-cell HAC loss is material fidelity counterevidence but does not quantify risk or benefit in MVA cells.

records.title: FOXM1 and Cancer: Faulty Cellular Signaling Derails Homeostasis.
records.note: The review describes FOXM1 regulation and cancer-associated signaling as potential therapeutic targets.
records.uncertainty: No named administered drug or independent efficacy result appears in the abstract.

records.title: Transcriptional control of mitosis: deregulation and cancer.
records.note: This review links altered transcription of mitotic regulators to aneuploidy and tumor formation.
records.uncertainty: It supplies mechanistic context without a tested rescue intervention.

records.title: Identification of hub genes in key hallmarks of ovarian cancer via bioinformatics analysis.
records.note: Expression and network analyses identified proliferation-related hallmarks and prognosis-associated hub genes.
records.uncertainty: Associations do not identify a demonstrated therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Centrosome dynamics as a source of chromosomal instability.
records.note: Centrosome separation and movement are discussed as contributors to erroneous chromosome attachments and segregation.
records.uncertainty: No specific compensatory intervention or independent functional rescue is described.

records.title: Cryo-EM structure of the deltaretroviral intasome in complex with the PP2A regulatory subunit B56γ.
records.model: Deltaretroviral integrase complexes with PP2A B56γ
records.note: Structures show how viral integrase recruits two PP2A regulatory subunits during integration-complex assembly.
records.uncertainty: The abstract provides no MVA-relevant intervention or chromosome-fidelity outcome.

records.title: The molecular balancing act of p16(INK4a) in cancer and aging.
records.note: The review describes p16-driven senescence as both tumor suppressive and a contributor to aging.
records.uncertainty: No tested pharmacologic compensation or tissue-function rescue is reported.

records.title: Heterochromatin-mediated association of achiasmate homologs declines with age when cohesion is compromised.
records.model: Aged Drosophila oocytes with ord and heterochromatin perturbations
records.note: Reduced cohesion compromised homolog pairing and increased age-associated nondisjunction.
records.uncertainty: This genetic mechanism offers no administered agent or demonstrated rescue.

records.title: DNA Methylation Based Molecular Subtypes Predict Prognosis in Breast Cancer Patients.
records.note: DNA methylation patterns defined prognostic subgroups and supported a survival-prediction model.
records.uncertainty: The analysis tests prognosis rather than a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Prc1-rich kinetochores are required for error-free acentrosomal spindle bipolarization during meiosis I in mouse oocytes.
records.note: Kinetochore recruitment of Prc1 through Ndc80 supported accurate spindle bipolarization in mouse meiosis I, whereas human oocytes lacked detectable enrichment.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not demonstrate pharmacologic rescue or transfer of this mechanism to BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: Loss of H3K27 tri-methylation is a diagnostic marker for malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors and an indicator for an inferior survival.
records.model: Peripheral nerve sheath and comparator tumor cohorts
records.note: Loss of H3K27 trimethylation marked a subset of aggressive tumors and poorer survival.
records.uncertainty: A diagnostic association does not establish a compensatory treatment.

records.title: Dynamic localization of Mps1 kinase to kinetochores is essential for accurate spindle microtubule attachment.
records.model: Cellular kinetochore and spindle attachment assays
records.note: Inactive Mps1 accumulation at kinetochores disrupted Ndc80–microtubule interactions and chromosome alignment.
records.uncertainty: No named drug or restoration of chromosome fidelity was reported.

records.title: Phosphorylation of Plk1 at Ser326 regulates its functions during mitotic progression.
records.model: Cultured-cell p38 or MK2 depletion models
records.note: Phosphomimetic Plk1-S326E rescued mitotic defects caused by p38 or MK2 depletion, linking kinase-pathway activity to spindle integrity.
records.uncertainty: The rescue is genetic and does not establish an administered drug or BUB1B-deficiency benefit.

records.title: Integrative analysis of prognostic value and immune infiltration of spindle and kinetochore-associated family members in breast cancer.
records.note: SKA-family expression correlated with poor prognosis, and gene silencing reduced cancer-cell proliferation and migration.
records.uncertainty: Silencing mitotic machinery in tumors is not evidence for correction of constitutional chromosome instability.

records.title: Xorbit/CLASP links dynamic microtubules to chromosomes in the Xenopus meiotic spindle.
records.note: Xorbit depletion or dominant-negative inhibition disrupted spindle assembly, alignment, and anaphase microtubule stability.
records.uncertainty: The abstract identifies an essential structural factor but no therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Studying chromosome instability in the mouse.
records.note: The review connects checkpoint gene disruption to developmental, tumor, and premature-aging phenotypes.
records.uncertainty: It is contextual literature synthesis without an independent drug-efficacy result.

records.title: Dual-functional significance of ATM-mediated phosphorylation of spindle assembly checkpoint component Bub3 in mitosis and the DNA damage response.
records.model: Cellular mitosis and ionizing-radiation DNA-damage assays
records.note: ATM phosphorylation of Bub3 Ser135 supported checkpoint activation and, after DNA damage, nonhomologous end joining.
records.uncertainty: No intervention enhancing this phosphorylation or rescuing BUB1B deficiency was demonstrated.

records.title: Baseline gene expression in subcutaneous adipose tissue predicts diet-induced weight loss in individuals with obesity.
records.model: 281 people with obesity in a dietary intervention
records.note: Baseline adipose expression predicted high versus low weight loss in a dietary study.
records.uncertainty: The abstract names no administered drug and does not test MVA-relevant function.

records.title: Initial testing of the CENP-E inhibitor GSK923295A by the pediatric preclinical testing program.
records.model: Pediatric cancer cell lines and mouse xenografts
records.note: CENP-E inhibition produced solid-tumor responses, but every tested leukemia xenograft in NOD/SCID mice showed excessive toxicity.
records.uncertainty: These tumor-model effects do not show normal-tissue rescue or define safety in MVA.

records.title: Human MMS21/NSE2 is a SUMO ligase required for DNA repair.
records.note: Wild-type hMMS21, but not a ligase-inactive mutant, rescued hypersensitivity to DNA damage after depletion.
records.uncertainty: This gene-replacement experiment does not demonstrate an administered compensatory agent.

records.title: Increased immunosuppression impairs tissue homeostasis with aging and age-related diseases.
records.note: The review describes anti-inflammatory compensation that may also promote senescence, fibrosis, and muscle atrophy.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered intervention or independent functional rescue is established.

records.title: Gene expression profiling in prognosis of distant recurrence in HR-positive and HER2-negative breast cancer patients.
records.note: An expression classifier predicted distant recurrence and largely agreed with an existing assay.
records.uncertainty: The study does not test chemotherapy efficacy or name an administered drug.

records.title: Aneuploidy in human eggs: contributions of the meiotic spindle.
records.note: The review relates error-prone spindle assembly and age-related kinetochore changes to egg aneuploidy.
records.uncertainty: No tested compensation or pharmacologic fidelity rescue is described.

records.title: Pig Taste Cell-derived Organoids Synthesize Insulin.
records.note: Insulin supported optimal organoid proliferation and differentiation, and differentiation conditions increased endogenous insulin content.
records.uncertainty: The niche organoid growth effect does not establish systemic functional compensation or MVA benefit.

records.title: Cancer Hallmarks Expression in Oral Leukoplakia: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
records.note: Proliferation, genomic instability, invasion, and immune-evasion markers associated with malignant transformation.
records.uncertainty: This synthesis provides neither an administered intervention nor independent treatment replication.

records.title: Plk1 is upregulated in androgen-insensitive prostate cancer cells and its inhibition leads to necroptosis.
records.note: BI2536 suppressed cancer-cell growth and induced multinucleation and necroptotic death; an unnamed necroptosis inhibitor partly reversed death.
records.uncertainty: The unnamed reversal agent cannot be identified from the abstract, and antitumor toxicity is not fidelity rescue.

records.title: Comparison of expression profiles in ovarian epithelium in vivo and ovarian cancer identifies novel candidate genes involved in disease pathogenesis.
records.model: Murine ovarian epithelium and human ovarian cancers
records.note: Comparison across estrous stages and tumors implicated chromosome-segregation genes and identified NUAK2 expression associations.
records.uncertainty: No drug or functional rescue was tested.

records.title: The broken "Off" switch in cancer signaling: PP2A as a regulator of tumorigenesis, drug resistance, and immune surveillance.

records.uncertainty: The abstract contains no independent administration experiment or chromosome-fidelity rescue.

records.title: Structural investigation of CDCA3-Cdh1 protein-protein interactions using in vitro studies and molecular dynamics simulation.
records.note: Phosphorylation and specific linker interactions stabilized CDCA3 binding to Cdh1 and regulated protein turnover.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or compensatory functional benefit was reported.

records.title: Transcriptional response profiles of paired tumor-normal samples offer novel perspectives in pan-cancer analysis.
records.model: Paired pan-cancer tissue datasets and cancer cells
records.note: Tumor-expression analysis identified candidate genes, and FAM64A or TROAP knockdown inhibited cancer-cell growth.

records.title: Comparison of global gene expression of gastric cardia and noncardia cancers from a high-risk population in china.

records.note: Transcriptomic profiling identified anatomic-subtype and survival-associated genes for subsequent investigation.
records.uncertainty: No treatment efficacy or functional compensation was evaluated.

records.title: Simultaneous Aurora-A/STK15 overexpression and centrosome amplification induce chromosomal instability in tumour cells with a MIN phenotype.

records.uncertainty: Rescue addressed engineered kinase overexpression and does not demonstrate pharmacologic correction of BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: SIRT2 Deacetylates and Inhibits the Peroxidase Activity of Peroxiredoxin-1 to Sensitize Breast Cancer Cells to Oxidant Stress-Inducing Agents.
records.model: Breast cancer cells and zebrafish embryos

records.title: A translational systems biology approach in both animals and humans identifies a functionally related module of accumbal genes involved in the regulation of reward processing and binge drinking in males.
records.model: Rasgrf2-null mice and adolescent male cohorts

records.uncertainty: No administered treatment or MVA-relevant rescue was evaluated.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint strength is linked to cell fate in the Caenorhabditis elegans embryo.

records.uncertainty: The abstract identifies determinants of checkpoint strength without a pharmacologic enhancement or deficiency rescue.

records.title: The Role of Sirtuins in Bone Repair From the Perspective of Glucose Metabolism.

records.uncertainty: Named agents, effect sizes, and independent functional efficacy are absent from the abstract.

records.title: Genome-wide association mapping in safflower (Carthamus tinctorius L.) for genetic dissection of drought tolerance using DArTseq markers.
records.model: 90 safflower genotypes under rainfed and irrigated conditions
records.note: Genetic markers were associated with drought tolerance and agronomic traits.
records.uncertainty: The plant breeding study offers no human therapeutic evidence.

records.title: A physiologic overview of the organ-specific transcriptome of the cattle tick Rhipicephalus microplus.
records.note: RNA sequencing characterized organ-specific expression involved in digestion, metabolism, and development.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or relevant functional rescue was reported.

records.title: CREB5 Promotes Resistance to Androgen-Receptor Antagonists and Androgen Deprivation in Prostate Cancer.

records.uncertainty: This resistance mechanism does not supply a tested compensatory treatment for MVA.

records.title: Exploiting immune-dependent effects of microtubule-targeting agents to improve efficacy and tolerability of cancer treatment.
records.note: The review discusses paclitaxel immune effects and proposes low-dose taxanes with checkpoint inhibitors while noting clinical toxicity of spindle-targeted drugs.
records.uncertainty: The proposed combination is not an independently tested efficacy result in this abstract.

records.title: Gene signature associated with benign neurofibroma transformation to malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors.
records.model: Human and mouse neurofibroma expression studies
records.note: Signature matching nominated trichostatin A, cantharidin, tamoxifen, and other histone-deacetylase inhibitors for malignant transformation.
records.uncertainty: The named drugs were computational candidates here, and cited prior experiments are not independent administration evidence.

records.title: Systematic review and integrated analysis of prognostic gene signatures for prostate cancer patients.
records.note: The review found recurring mitotic and cell-cycle genes across prognostic signatures.
records.uncertainty: It tests neither a drug nor a functional rescue strategy.

records.title: Musashi1 Contribution to Glioblastoma Development via Regulation of a Network of DNA Replication, Cell Cycle and Division Genes.
records.note: Musashi1 knockout increased sensitivity to unnamed cell-cycle and DNA-replication inhibitors.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not identify administered compounds or demonstrate a MVA-relevant benefit.

records.title: Clinical implications of prospective genomic profiling of metastatic breast cancer patients.
records.note: Sequencing identified potentially actionable alterations and influenced referrals or therapy decisions in some patients.
records.uncertainty: No named administered drug or comparative efficacy result was provided.

records.title: Identification of Novel Prognostic Biomarkers for Colorectal Cancer by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.note: Increasing ST3GAL5 or GBA2 expression suppressed malignant cellular behavior after bioinformatic candidate identification.
records.uncertainty: Genetic antitumor effects do not identify an administered drug or demonstrate MVA compensation.

records.title: The CCAN recruits CENP-A to the centromere and forms the structural core for kinetochore assembly.
records.note: Targeted kinetochore proteins built functional ectopic kinetochores, including configurations lacking CENP-A and most CCAN components.
records.uncertainty: This engineered assembly experiment does not provide a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Some assembly required: Redefining the mitotic checkpoint.
records.note: The article proposes overlapping checkpoint pathways for monitoring kinetochore attachment and spindle assembly.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or new efficacy outcome is stated.

records.title: Molecular profiling of peripheral blood is associated with circulating tumor cells content and poor survival in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
records.note: Blood gene-expression patterns correlated with circulating tumor cells and prognosis.
records.uncertainty: The prognostic model supplies no therapeutic efficacy evidence.

records.title: IER5, a DNA damage response gene, is required for Notch-mediated induction of squamous cell differentiation.
records.model: Squamous carcinoma cells and immortalized keratinocytes
records.note: Conditional Notch activation promoted differentiation through IER5 and interaction with PP2A B55α.
records.uncertainty: The abstract names no administered drug and does not test deficient chromosome segregation.

records.title: Upregulation of multiple key molecules is correlated with poor prognosis and immune infiltrates in hepatocellular carcinoma by bulk and single-cell RNA-seq.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma bulk and single-cell datasets
records.note: Expression and immune-infiltration analysis produced a prognostic gene model.
records.uncertainty: No functional drug benefit or compensation was tested.

records.title: Insights into degron recognition by APC/C coactivators from the structure of an Acm1-Cdh1 complex.
records.note: The complex structure defined degron recognition and pseudosubstrate inhibition of APC/C coactivators.
records.uncertainty: Structural target information alone does not establish a rescue strategy.

records.title: Protein Phosphatases Involved in Regulating Mitosis: Facts and Hypotheses.
records.note: The review catalogs spatial and temporal phosphatase roles in mitotic progression and chromosome control.
records.uncertainty: No particular administered intervention or independent efficacy evidence is given.

records.title: M2I-1 disrupts the in vivo interaction between CDC20 and MAD2 and increases the sensitivities of cancer cell lines to anti-mitotic drugs via MCL-1s.
records.note: M2I-1 enhanced antimitotic-drug killing while disrupting checkpoint-complex assembly and promoting premature Cyclin B1 degradation.
records.uncertainty: This is relevant counterevidence for using MCC inhibition to preserve fidelity, not evidence of benefit in MVA.

records.title: Anoikis resistance in Cancer: Mechanisms, therapeutic strategies, potential targets, and models for enhanced understanding.
records.note: The review summarizes resistance mechanisms, model systems, and potential therapeutic targets.
records.uncertainty: No named administered drug or independent rescue result is provided.

records.title: Moonlighting in Mitosis: Analysis of the Mitotic Functions of Transcription and Splicing Factors.
records.model: Transcription and splicing factors with mitotic roles
records.note: The review catalogs secondary mitotic functions of proteins primarily associated with interphase gene regulation.
records.uncertainty: It does not test a treatment or show functional compensation.

records.title: Network pharmacological approach combined with weighted gene co-expression network analysis identifies CDKN2A as the keg target of Changweiqing against colorectal cancer.
records.model: Colorectal cancer cells and network-pharmacology analyses
records.note: Quercetin arrested cells in G0/G1 and reduced viability; broader Changweiqing constituent-target claims came from computational analysis.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not show administration of the full mixture or an anti-aging, fidelity, or MVA benefit.

records.title: SUMOylation-Mediated Regulation of Cell Cycle Progression and Cancer.
records.note: The review links regulated SUMOylation to mitosis and genomic stability and discusses tumor dependence on the pathway.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or corrective intervention is demonstrated.

records.title: Functional Foods and Micro- and Nanoplastics: Advances in Precision Nutritional Medicine for Oral-Gut-Brain Axis Health.
records.model: Functional foods and micro/nanoplastic exposure literature
records.note: The review discusses dietary compounds and Nrf2-mediated barrier and inflammation protection, while acknowledging limited human evidence.
records.uncertainty: Its named ingredients are literature examples rather than independent administration results in this record.

records.title: Schizosaccharomyces pombe Bub3 is dispensable for mitotic arrest following perturbed spindle formation.
records.model: Fission yeast bub3 and rae1 mutants
records.note: Bub3-null yeast retained spindle-disruption arrest but showed altered mitotic timing and sister-centromere association.
records.uncertainty: Yeast checkpoint dispensability cannot be assumed to compensate for human BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: TNMplot.com: A Web Tool for the Comparison of Gene Expression in Normal, Tumor and Metastatic Tissues.
records.model: Normal, tumor, and metastatic transcriptome datasets
records.note: The study assembled a public expression-comparison resource and validated differential-expression patterns.
records.uncertainty: This resource supplies no direct efficacy experiment.

records.title: Checkpoint-independent stabilization of kinetochore-microtubule attachments by Mad2 in human cells.
records.model: Human cells with Mad2 overexpression or Mad1 depletion
records.note: Mad2 overexpression hyperstabilized kinetochore–microtubule attachments and impaired error correction independently of checkpoint signaling.

records.title: Integrated analysis of uterine leiomyosarcoma and leiomyoma utilizing TCGA and GEO data: a WGCNA and machine learning approach.
records.note: Network and machine-learning analyses identified mitotic genes as candidate tumor biomarkers.

records.title: Role of Plant-Derived Active Constituents in Cancer Treatment and Their Mechanisms of Action.
records.note: The review summarizes anticancer findings for several phytochemicals across laboratory and clinical literature.
records.uncertainty: Named examples are not independent administration experiments, and no MVA-relevant functional rescue is specified.

records.title: Aging of Vascular System Is a Complex Process: The Cornerstone Mechanisms.

records.uncertainty: No administered compound or specific efficacy result appears in the abstract.

records.title: Network integration of thermal proteome profiling with multi-omics data decodes PARP inhibition.

records.uncertainty: The inhibitor is unnamed and no relevant functional benefit is demonstrated.

records.title: Targeting the mitotic checkpoint to kill tumor cells.

records.title: Role of DNA methylation in the nucleus accumbens in incubation of cocaine craving.

records.title: Complex Commingling: Nucleoporins and the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint.

records.title: RBFOX2 regulated EYA3 isoforms partner with SIX4 or ZBTB1 to control transcription during myogenesis.

records.title: PLK1 in cancer therapy: a comprehensive review of immunomodulatory mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities.
records.note: The review discusses PLK1 inhibition as a chemotherapy, radiation, and immunotherapy adjunct.
records.uncertainty: No named administered compound or independent MVA-relevant efficacy result is given.

records.title: Activating the Anaphase Promoting Complex to Enhance Genomic Stability and Prolong Lifespan.

records.note: The review links APC activity to stress responses, genomic stability, and yeast longevity, suggesting nutrient-response control as a potential intervention axis.

records.title: How cyclin A destruction escapes the spindle assembly checkpoint.

records.title: AMPKα2 activation by an energy-independent signal ensures chromosomal stability during mitosis.

records.title: Integrated Network Analysis Decipher ZNF384-Related miR-20b-5p and miR-424-5p in Colon Adenocarcinoma.

records.title: Contingent Synergistic Interactions between Non-Coding RNAs and DNA-Modifying Enzymes in Myelodysplastic Syndromes.

records.title: Transcriptome Dynamics and Regulatory Networks of Postnatal Muscle Development in Leizhou Black Goats.

records.title: Histone H3 K27M-mediated regulation of cancer cell stemness and differentiation in diffuse midline glioma.

records.title: Heterogeneous architecture of vertebrate kinetochores revealed by three-dimensional superresolution fluorescence microscopy.

records.title: Mapping Mitotic Death: Functional Integration of Mitochondria, Spindle Assembly Checkpoint and Apoptosis.

records.title: Peptide inhibitors of the anaphase promoting-complex that cause sensitivity to microtubule poison.

administered_agents.name: Tyc1
administered_agents.role: Yeast peptide expressed and tested for APC/C inhibition

records.model: Budding yeast and in-vitro APC/C assays
records.note: Cdc20-derived peptides inhibited APC/C and delayed securin degradation during recovery from poison arrest. Tyc1 separately inhibited APC/C and sensitized yeast to an unnamed microtubule poison; the abstract does not assign the securin-delay measurement to Tyc1.
records.uncertainty: These peptides are mechanistic tools, with no evidence of improved segregation fidelity or MVA benefit.

records.title: Identification of noninvasive imaging surrogates for brain tumor gene-expression modules.

records.title: Transcriptomics analysis and hormonal changes of male and female neonatal rats treated chronically with a low dose of acrylamide in their drinking water.
records.note: Acrylamide altered repair, segregation, oxidative-stress pathways and thyroid hormones with sampling-time dependence.
records.uncertainty: This is carcinogen exposure rather than a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Alternative splicing and MicroRNA: epigenetic mystique in male reproduction.

records.uncertainty: No independent administered drug or MVA compensation is demonstrated.

records.model: Lung adenocarcinoma microarrays and L1000 perturbation data
records.note: The study proposed vorinostat–dorsomorphin, PP-110–dorsomorphin, and puromycin–vorinostat combinations from expression/network analyses.

records.title: C9ORF78 partially localizes to centromeres and plays a role in chromosome segregation.
records.model: HeLa cells and C9ORF78 reporter/knockdown assays
records.note: C9ORF78 responded to serum/transcription factors, localized partly to kinetochores, and was needed for normal mitosis.
records.uncertainty: Serum stimulation and gene perturbation do not establish a drug rescue.

records.title: Structural and mechanistic insights into Mps1 kinase activation.

records.uncertainty: No administered treatment or compensatory efficacy is tested.

records.title: IUGR impairs cardiomyocyte growth and maturation in fetal sheep.
records.model: Heat-induced placental insufficiency and fetal growth restriction in sheep
records.note: Growth restriction reduced cardiomyocyte number, maturity, size, and cell-cycle activity alongside altered hormones.
records.uncertainty: IGF1 is proposed from endogenous signaling associations and was not administered as treatment.

records.title: Distribution and effects of nonsense polymorphisms in human genes.

records.uncertainty: No read-through drug or gene-correction intervention is tested.

records.title: Investigation of potential molecular biomarkers and small molecule drugs for hepatocellular carcinoma transformed from cirrhosis.
records.model: Cirrhosis/HCC expression data and toxicogenomics database
records.note: Estradiol, benzo(a)pyrene, acetaminophen, copper sulfate, and bisphenol A were associated with differential-expression hubs.
records.uncertainty: These are database associations, including toxicants, and not administered therapeutic candidates with measured efficacy.

records.title: FGFR2 is essential for salivary gland duct homeostasis and MAPK-dependent seromucous acinar cell differentiation.
records.model: Mouse salivary glands and single-cell expression assays

records.uncertainty: The abstract does not clearly describe exogenous FGF7 dosing or functional rescue of damaged glands.
